name: Yuuya Bridges
source:
Formerly of the US Army Combat Technology Research Unit. At the top of his class in both practical combat skill and book learning. He is the main test pilot for the XFJ Joint US-Japan TSF Development Project, and serves as a member of the project’s Argus Test Flight. His father is Japanese and his mother is American. When he was young, political friction between Japan and America made him the subject of anti-Japanese discrimination. He grew up to hate America, and develop a cold attitude that keeps others at bay.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
